reviews.title: Used to be amazing
reviews.text: I used to love this app. The horoscopes felt personal, the daily insights were scarily accurate, and it was super fun to use. Now, every horoscope is clearly written with ai, littered with emdashes and adverbs like quietly. It’s disappointing. Part of the allure of CoStar was that it was personal. The first year I started using it, not a single horoscope repeated; now I check the app and I have the same dos and don’ts and day-at-a-glance at least 5 times a month. Either the creators sold the company or they got lazy and started using AI. As a true believer in astrology, I loved the specific advice. Everything feels so vague that I don’t believe what the app says anymore. It’s marketed as “personalized astrology” but both the insights on the app and Co-Stars social media presence feels so inaccurate and impersonal that it makes me angry. I deleted my account because it’s a shame that such a special app was ruined by AI.

I genuinely feel I get better horoscopes from social media.

reviews.title: Paywalls=Predatory
reviews.text: I’ve had this app since it first came out, and within the last couple years, it has just been going farther and farther downhill. I loved that it was a way to get to know astrology and natal charts, provided daily horoscopes, and allowed you to see friend’s charts/horoscopes. Now you don’t even get to see your daily horoscope unless you pay for it. That’s bs. I was fine with the paying to get the year ahead readings, the ones that dive deeper into relationships and family, and even paying to message “the void”. I never did pay for those things, beyond when they first came out to see what they even were, but adding extra features behind a paywall is whatever. Taking away the very basics of the app and putting them behind a paywall after years of it being free is screwed up though. After many, many years, I’ll be deleting my account and then the app, unless this “update” (it’s a downgrade) is reversed asap, because it is essentially useless now in every sort of way. Disappointed :(
